newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Demand, prices ease.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Demand, prices ease.

text.p: U.S. millfeed markets were mostly quiet Tuesday, and many dealers reported supplies were tight for prompt shipment.

However, prices eased at some locations as demand remained light with feedmixers buying just enough for immediate needs. Also, with the winter wheat harvest two months away, mixers and livestock feeders expect lower millfeed prices as supplies increase.
Clear weather in the U.S. Midwest and Plains also had farmers in the fields planting corn rather than buying feed.
Dealers said feed sales have slipped because spring pastures have lessened the demand for feed. Also, farmers were buying less as they concentrated on planting corn and soybeans.
A dealer who does business in the Carolinas said nearby supplies remain tight possibly because of reduced flour mill production.
Buffalo sources said a slight increase in flour mill production made for ample supplies in that market, which weighed slightly on offers.
